abstract: We have treated 90 cases of testicular tumors at our institutes from April, 1962 to March, 1986. Of 75 which were germ cell type tumors, 35 were a seminoma, for which the 5-year survival rate was 100% for patients in stage I, and 50% for those in stage III, respectively. Forty cases were non-seminomas, and all cases determined as being in stage I survived for 5 years, whereas 47.6% cases of those in stage III survived for 4.5 years. Thirty-six percent of those with a stage I germ cell tumor were treated with a orchiectomy alone, while other cases also combined radiotherapy and/or chemotherapy. Almost all cases of an advanced tumor received combined retroperitoneal lymph node resection, radiotherapy and/or chemotherapy. Patients with an advanced nonseminomatous tumor showed better a survival rate if they were given CDDP chemotherapy.
abstract_ja: 1962年4月から1986年3月までに、当施設および関連施設で治療した精巣腫瘍90例を再評価した。胚細胞腫瘍75例のうち、セミノーマは35例で、病期Iの5年生存率は100%、病期IIIでは50%であった。非セミノーマは40例で、病期Iの症例は全例が5年生存し、病期IIIの症例は47.6%が4.5年生存した。病期Iの胚細胞腫瘍の36%は精巣摘除術単独で治療され、その他の症例では放射線療法や化学療法を併用した。進行腫瘍の症例はほぼ全例が後腹膜リンパ節の併用切除、放射線療法、化学療法の併用治療を受けた。進行非セミノーマ症例では、CDDPによる化学療法を受けた場合に生存率が良好であった。
